semantics: Identical scheduler, order, quantum and yields. Optional callback reads counters and generator locals between existing sweeps; it does not resume or mutate an invocation.
timeout_policy: Retain existing 100000000 event bound per dispatch and 500000000 instruction bound per invocation, fail closed as Unfinished. No estimated duration is a timeout. Parent supervises live persisted counters; inspect prolonged lack of counter change rather than claiming progress from process liveness. Task remains active until terminal result or verified blocker.
